name: Cava
author: syzyf97
description: Audio visualizer in the bar, powered by cava and colored by the current theme

schema.label: Audio source
schema.description: "output" for what is playing, "input" for the default microphone, or a PipeWire device name (list them with omarchy-cava-settings --sources).

schema.label: Lowest frequency (Hz)
schema.description: Bottom of the frequency range shown by the bars.

schema.label: Highest frequency (Hz)
schema.description: Top of the frequency range shown by the bars.

schema.label: Sensitivity (%)
schema.description: Bar height in percent. With auto sensitivity off, quiet music usually needs 500-2000. With auto sensitivity on, this is only the starting value.

schema.label: Auto sensitivity
schema.description: Let cava adjust sensitivity to the volume so bars neither clip nor stay flat.

schema.label: Color
schema.description: Theme color used for the bars.

schema.label: Hide when silent
schema.description: Hide the widget while nothing is playing.
